## Maps and Tokens for Chapter 5

Session 5 is divine confrontation on the parade ground of Vindolanda. The fort is the arena. All maps must feel isolated, vast, and wrong. Load all maps before players join — transition happens at exactly the moment the sand appears.

### Scene → Map → Tokens

| Scene | Map File | Tokens to Place | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scene 0: Arrival (cold open) | `CityStreets` or `BridgeCheckpoint` | All PCs, Augur_Cassia, Centurion_Varro, Legate_Corvinus, Tribune_Lucius, Vercingetorix | Fort parade ground. Freeze time at opening. Witnesses stand at edge — do not move their tokens. Mars: no token, narrate only. |
| Scene 1: Mars Specifies Trial | Same map | Same | No new tokens. Mars speaks from the throne position. Players declare their option. |
| Scene 2A: Champion Trial | `AncientAltar` | All PCs + Fausta_Luperci | Fausta forms from ash at start. Arena weapons along perimeter: place 5 prop tokens as markers. |
| Scene 2B: Trial of Blades | `AncientAltar` | All PCs + Mars (if using token) | Phasing buildings appear each round — use Wight/Shadow tokens as rubble/hazard markers. Summon fallen: Wight ×1 or Shadow ×1 per Legendary Action. Max 3. |
| Scene 2C: Trial of Voice | `AncientAltar` | All PCs | No combat tokens. Mars seated on throne. Players move tokens forward to the center as they argue. |
| Scene 3: Price of Standing | `AncientAltar` | Same + Augur_Cassia (approaches) | Mars steps off throne. Cassia and Varro unfreeze and approach. |
| Scene 4: Return to Vindolanda | `CityStreets` or original fort map | All PCs, all witness NPCs | Time resumes. Cohort collapses to knees. Messenger arrives with citizenship document. |
| Scene 4 (underground retreat) | `DarkTempleInterior` | All PCs | If party retreats below the fort during Option B — same vault as Sessions 1 and 4. |
| Scene 5: Epilogue | `NatureGoddessTemple`, `IslandRuins` | Relevant PCs + Thusnelda (grove scenes) | One year later. Not the same session; epilogue is narrated, not mapped unless players want it. |

**Special: Labyrinth Ruins**

If the party attempts to destroy the spear's remains in the ruins rather than return them to the grove:

| Map | `LabyrinthRuins` |
|---|---|
| Tokens | All PCs; Senator_Brutus agents if Brutus sent operatives |
| Notes | Contested — Brutus' men may arrive to seize the ashes. This is an improvised scene if it happens. |

### Scene 0 Arena Setup

The parade ground transforms before combat. Use these positional notes:

| Position | Element | Token/Marker |
|---|---|---|
| Center | Mars' throne of weapons | Large object token or no token (narrate) |
| North edge | Gate witnesses (Varro, legionaries) | Centurion_Varro + Guard ×4 |
| East edge | Religious witnesses (Cassia, Paterculus) | Augur_Cassia + Paterculus_AugurAssist |
| South edge | Political witnesses (Corvinus, Lucius) | Legate_Corvinus + Tribune_Lucius |
| West edge | Germanic witnesses (Vercingetorix) | Vercingetorix + Edda_SpearMother |
| Perimeter (5 points) | Arena weapon markers | Use prop/marker tokens, label Card I–V |

### Map Files Location

Campaign session folder: `Maptool/maps/campaign/S5_The_Wrath_of_Mars/`

```
CityStreets             — fort exterior, parade ground (Scene 0 + Scene 4)
BridgeCheckpoint        — alternate fort exterior if CityStreets unavailable
AncientAltar            — divine arena, black sand circle (Scenes 2–3)
DarkTempleInterior      — vault beneath fort (retreat + Option B underground)
CathedralCatacombs      — extended underground retreat if needed
AncientTombs            — deeper underground; optional
NatureGoddessTemple     — sacred grove (epilogue); same map as Ch1 altar chamber
IslandRuins             — grove perimeter or labyrinth approach
LabyrinthRuins          — spear destruction site (improvised scene)
```

Run `bash Maptool/build_campaign_maps.sh` to copy session tokens into this folder (idempotent).

### The Arena as Callback

Scene 2 uses `AncientAltar`. Scene 4's citizenship moment returns to the fort exterior. Scene 3 (underground retreat option) uses `DarkTempleInterior` — the same vault used in Sessions 1 and 4.

If the party descends: *"The altar. The chains. Fausta's ghost, if she appeared, has not remained. But the chain anchors in the floor are new marks — scored by a god's weight. Mars sat here. You can feel where."*

The campaign began in this stone chamber. It can end there.
